gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2020, Syndicate 1884 experienced a net claims release of GBP 3.1 million for the 2018 Year of Account. However, this was partially offset by strengthening of Political Risk reserves, which saw adverse development stemming from specific experience and a re-evaluation in light of deteriorating global economic conditions.

The opening reserves are gross. The claims development table on page 33 shows a gross release of GBP 0.816m for underwriting years 2015-2018, which differs from the net figure for the 2018 YOA.

gpt-5-mini.exact_reserve_text: The 2018 YOA result has improved by 9.3% in calendar year 2020, notwithstanding strengthening of reserves in respect of unexpired political risk policies exposed to worsening global economic conditions.
gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 was GBP 114.931m. During calendar year 2020 the 2018 year of account improved by approximately GBP 9.3m (a release), driven by better than previously forecast written premiums and favourable run-off experience and reserve releases across most classes. Offsetting this were reserve-strengthening actions in Political Risk and Directors & Officers driven by specific adverse experience and a re-evaluation in light of deteriorating global economic conditions. Reinsurance arrangements were restructured and renewed during the year which also influenced the net underwriting outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: Better than previously forecast written premiums, primarily arising from the Political risk, Cargo, Hull and Energy classes.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 3 (explicit). Prior-year development derived from the run-off manager narrative comparing forecast ultimate result at 31 Dec 2019 (GBP 44.7m) to ultimate on closing 2018 YOA (GBP 35.4m) giving a GBP 9.3m improvement (release). No single line-item labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' is provided; the reserve movement figure was inferred from narrative and closing/forecast ultimate figures (confidence 0.8). Per-LOB reserve movements are not quantified in the report; listed LOB directions are inferred from narrative ('reserve releases across all classes except Political Risk and D&O'). RITC transactions and closure of the 2018 YOA into 2021 may distort some reserve comparatives.
